From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-12 14:05 PST
Subject: Re: Request: time-boxed audit access for on-prem deployment (MediArc)

Marissa / Claire —

Thanks for flagging. Below are legal's preliminary positions and a redline-ready snippet we can drop into an Exhibit to the MSA / Order Form. I’ve attached a short PDF with the proposed Exhibit A (proposed-exhibit-A.pdf).

High-level positions:
- Time-boxed access: Redwood can provide a witnessed, read-only console session limited to a continuous window not to exceed 48 hours for the specific verification activities enumerated in Exhibit A. Access will be scoped to the resources identified in the Order Form and will not include any background data export.
- Data residency: Redwood will ensure that ephemeral snapshots and audit logs produced for the purpose of the witnessed session are stored within EU physical regions. Persistent logs required for platform operations will remain under Redwood’s standard retention unless expressly excluded by an additional data handling exhibit.
- Key custody: Preferred model is client-managed KMS (customer holds primary key). If a split-key model is required, we will require a neutral third-party HSM custodian. Redwood proposes KeyHold Partners (or equivalent), with an escrow arrangement limited to recovery only. Any third-party custody arrangement will require a short DPA amendment and background attestation from the HSM vendor.
- PII minimization: Any recordings or snapshots will have PII redacted or masked to the extent technically feasible; full forensic artifacts can be provided only under a court-ordered or agreed-forensic procedure.

Suggested clause (Exhibit A excerpt):
"For the purpose of Customer verification of configuration and operational controls related to the On-Prem Deployment, Redwood Inference will, upon reasonable prior notice and subject to the terms below, provide a single, time-boxed, read-only witnessed session (the 'Witnessed Session') not to exceed 48 hours. The Witnessed Session will be limited to the resources and dates specified in the Order Form. Redwood will store any artifacts created for the Witnessed Session in EU physical regions and will apply PII minimization prior to delivery. Customer may request use of a neutral HSM custodian for split-key arrangements; Redwood will require an executed DPA addendum specific to third-party custodians and an attestation from the custodian confirming controls and jurisdictional commitments."

Next steps:
1) If Customer confirms split-key preference, please provide proposed custodian (Entrustify or equivalent).
2) We’ll prepare the single-page Exhibit A redline and circulate via DocuSign for execution alongside the Order Form.

Attachment: proposed-exhibit-A.pdf (pdf, 28 KB)

-Karthik Iyer
Associate General Counsel — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

--
Note: Laura — please confirm operational feasibility for producing EU-only ephemeral artifacts and whether we can support the 48-hour witnessed window without impacting scheduled maintenance windows.
